behavior.arguments: rdi = struct pointer; the window reads byte [rdi], zero-extends it, scales it by 8, and loads one qword from each of two tables
behavior.branch_order: no branches, no calls: straight-line load/load/return
behavior.output_shape: rdx = tableA[index] (0x7c13f8, .rodata); rax = tableB[index] (0x5749c90, .data.rel.ro); table-B runtime contents are load-time values and are not claimed
behavior.rule: i = movzbl [rdi]; rdx = tableA[i]; rax = tableB[i]; 8-byte entries, index scaled by 8
behavior.table_b_contents: not claimed: file entries all zero, 127 R_X86_64_RELATIVE relocations fill the 256-entry range at load time

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

data_edge.naming_slot_note: exactly one relocation record in any .rela.* section names this window as addend: R_X86_64_RELATIVE at slot 0x57494c0 in .data.rel.ro; it is a single naming slot, and its meaning is not claimed
data_edge.table_b_note: table B base 0x5749c90 in .data.rel.ro; file entries all zero; 127 R_X86_64_RELATIVE relocations target slots within its 256-entry range, so runtime contents are unknowable from the file alone
